headline: European quantum is moving from research to industrial scale, led by Finland's IQM (listed on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Helsinki in July 2026) and a heavy EU call round, but private capital still lags the US.
outlook_reason: IQM's listing and €102M backlog, a large EU/EuroHPC call round closing in November 2026 and growing Finnish ecosystem funding point to rising demand, although the EU private-capital gap and an unconfirmed Quantum Act remain risks.

signals.title: IQM reports first results as public company
signals.detail: H1 revenue €8.9M, operating loss €60.5M, backlog above €102.1M, full-year outlook confirmed. 26 systems sold, 17 delivered.

signals.title: IQM wins €33M CSC contract for LUMI AI Factory
signals.detail: Quantum computer to be integrated into LUMI AI Factory (July 2026; exact day not confirmed). IQM also listed on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Helsinki in July.

signals.title: IQM Q3 2026 results due today
signals.detail: Date moved from 3 Nov to 5 Nov. Figures were not available at the time of this update.

signals.title: Bluefors and Verda become Finnish unicorns
signals.detail: Dealroom lists Bluefors (cryogenics) among September 2026 new unicorns (exact day not given); Algorithmiq raised a €18M Series B in May 2026.

signals.title: Nordic Quantum Alliance launched
signals.detail: Nordic quantum organisations from DK, FI, NO, SE formed an alliance.

signals.title: First private-enterprise IQM sale
signals.detail: Poland's Galaxy Systemy Informatyczne buys a 54-qubit system, delivery Q4 2026.

signals.title: Scaleup Europe Fund first investment: Quantum Motion $160M
signals.detail: First deal of the EU fund went to a UK silicon-spin quantum company.

signals.title: EU Quantum Act status unconfirmed
signals.detail: Proposal was planned for Q2 2026 in the Commission work programme. I found no confirmation that it has been adopted; check the Commission's page.

companies.name: IQM Quantum Computers
companies.what: Superconducting quantum computers, Aalto/VTT-origin, Espoo fab; listed on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Helsinki July 2026; installed a 20-qubit system at Aalto.

companies.name: Bluefors
companies.what: Dilution refrigerators and cryogenic systems for quantum computers; Aalto-linked; reported as new unicorn Sept 2026.

companies.name: Algorithmiq
companies.what: Quantum algorithms and software for life sciences; €18M Series B in May 2026 (per Dealroom).

companies.name: SemiQon
companies.what: Cryo-CMOS and silicon quantum devices, VTT spin-off (details not verified in this run).

companies.name: QMill
companies.what: Quantum software and algorithms, Aalto-linked; demonstrated quantum-enhanced mobile network encryption with Telia (May 2026).

companies.name: Quantum Motion
companies.what: Silicon spin qubits; $160M round, first investment of EU Scaleup Europe Fund.

companies.name: Pasqal
companies.what: Neutral-atom quantum computers, IQM's European peer.

companies.name: Quantonation
companies.what: Deep-physics VC; closed €220M fund Feb 2026; potential investor for spin-offs.
